items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I never will forget my teacher. She was a beautiful lady named Mrs. Bailey

ctx.x: Well, I worked up to be one of the best drummers around, and in fact I was, you know, flipping sticks on the floor, catching them behind my back, and twirling them, and beating, and imitating these guys, and I would say maybe I was about number five. I was about the fifth best.

So I started taking my drum -- the snare drum -- buckle it on to me, to school when I was in elementary school. I think maybe by then I was in about the third grade. And I never will forget my teacher. She was a beautiful lady named Mrs. Bailey, and I used to play --
